name: Dynamic Leg Swing with Support

instructions.description: Stand beside a chair and hold it for support.
Swing one leg forward and backward through a small range.
Keep the trunk upright and movement controlled.
Slow the leg, then repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Dynamic Leg Swing with Support — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use small controlled swings and stable support.
